# GreenWire Zrt. — Equipment framework

GreenWire Zrt. supplies network switches and equipment maintenance for Project Beacon and Project Bridge North. The framework renews on 2027-06-30. Budapest office devices and northern training terminals use separate delivery schedules under the same agreement. Procurement owns the commercial acceptance record and approves any change in ordered quantities.

The supplier labels each carton with its purchase order and delivery location. The receiving employee checks the carton before signing the delivery note. A damaged carton is photographed while sealed. The serial number inventory is checked after installation; a signature at reception confirms receipt of a carton rather than technical acceptance of the device inside it.

Replacement devices must arrive with the approved firmware release identified on the service sheet. The engineer records the installed version before connecting the device to the relevant segment. A device that fails the acceptance check returns to the marked quarantine shelf. The supplier can collect it only after the site coordinator has copied the service sheet into the purchasing record.

Maintenance includes a remote diagnostic session followed by an agreed site visit when necessary. The northern site requires a station number and an escort for access to training areas. A call about a printer queue may need an application coordinator before hardware is replaced. Site travel outside the planned window requires a written charge approval.

Procurement has asked for unused spare stock to be counted at the quarterly review. The agreement does not allow departments to transfer a sealed spare device to another site without updating its location. Packaging disposal and the return of obsolete devices are scheduled separately from installation. The supplier will quote any additional terminal station as a new service line.
